PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(npm run dev|pnpm( run)? dev|yarn dev)" && tool_input.command matches "(backend|frontend)"

hooks.command: node -e "console.error('[RevClear Hook] Backend runs on port 3005, Frontend on port 3000');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Use separate tmux sessions for each: tmux new -s backend/frontend')"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const ns=i.tool_input?.new_string||'';if(/password|secret|key|token/i.test(ns)&&!/process\.env/.test(ns)&&!/(test|mock|example)/i.test(ns)){console.error('[RevClear Hook] WARNING: Potential hardcoded credentials detected');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Use environment variables for sensitive data (HIPAA compliance)')}console.log(d)})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const ns=i.tool_input?.new_string||'';if(/(patient|medical|phi|ssn|dob)/i.test(ns)&&/console\.log|console\.debug/.test(ns)){console.error('[RevClear Hook] BLOCKED: PHI logging detected - HIPAA violation');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Never log patient data or PHI to console');process.exit(1)}console.log(d)})"
node -e "console.error('[RevClear Hook] Remember: Backend deps in backend/, Frontend deps in frontend/');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Verify you are in the correct directory')"
node -e "console.error('[RevClear Hook] Genkit flows require rebuild: npm run build:genkit');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Test flows in Genkit Dev UI on port 4001')"
node -e "console.error('[RevClear Hook] Commit created - ensure no PHI in commit message');console.error('[RevClear Hook] Run tests before push: npm test in backend/')"

node -e "console.error('');console.error('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════');console.error('  RevClear - Medical Claims Platform');console.error('  Backend: port 3005 | Frontend: port 3000');console.error('  Remember: HIPAA compliance - no PHI in logs/commits');console.error('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════');console.error('')"
